description: This classic New York Baked Cheesecake boasts a rich, creamy texture and a perfectly golden crust. It's a truly indulgent American dessert, celebrated for its smooth, dense consistency and tangy-sweet flavor. Prepare to impress with this iconic treat, perfect for any special occasion or a delightful family gathering.

instructions.title: Prepare the Crust
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 350F (175C). In a medium bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, and melted butter. Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan. Bake for 10 minutes, then remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly while you prepare the filling. Reduce oven temperature to 325F (160C).

instructions.title: Make the Filling
instructions.text: In a large mixing bowl, using an electric mixer on medium speed, beat the softened cream cheese until smooth and creamy, about 2-3 minutes. Gradually add the 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar and flour, beating until just combined and smooth. Do not overmix.

instructions.title: Incorporate Eggs and Flavorings
instructions.text: Add the eggs one at a time, beating on low speed after each addition until just incorporated. Scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed. Stir in the sour cream, vanilla extract, and lemon zest (if using) until just combined. The mixture should be smooth and lump-free.

instructions.title: Prepare for Baking with Water Bath
instructions.text: Wrap the outside of your springform pan tightly with several layers of heavy-duty aluminum foil to prevent water from seeping in. Pour the cheesecake filling over the cooled crust in the springform pan. Place the foil-wrapped springform pan into a larger roasting pan. Carefully pour hot water into the roasting pan until it reaches about halfway up the sides of the springform pan. This creates a water bath, crucial for a creamy, crack-free cheesecake.

instructions.title: Bake the Cheesecake
instructions.text: Carefully transfer the roasting pan with the cheesecake to the preheated oven. Bake for 1 hour 15 minutes, or until the edges are set but the center still jiggles slightly when gently shaken. Do not overbake. Turn off the oven, crack the oven door open slightly, and let the cheesecake cool in the water bath inside the oven for 1 hour.

instructions.title: Cool and Chill
instructions.text: Remove the cheesecake from the oven and carefully lift it out of the water bath. Remove the foil. Let it cool completely on a wire rack at room temperature for at least 2 hours. Once cooled, cover the cheesecake loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, or preferably overnight, for best texture and flavor.

instructions.title: Serve Your Cheesecake
instructions.text: Once thoroughly chilled, run a thin knife around the edge of the springform pan before releasing the sides. Slice and serve your authentic New York Baked Cheesecake plain, or with fresh berries, fruit compote, or a drizzle of chocolate sauce. Enjoy this classic American dessert!

tips: Always use room temperature cream cheese, eggs, and sour cream. This ensures a smooth, lump-free batter and prevents overmixing, which can lead to cracks.
The water bath is essential for even baking and to prevent cracking. It provides a moist environment, keeping the top from drying out and creating a perfectly creamy texture.
Chilling the cheesecake for at least 6 hours, or overnight, is crucial. It allows the cheesecake to firm up and develop its signature dense, rich texture and flavor.
